findings.highlight: I don't think Tohsaka is the type to get into trouble, but I also know she sometimes makes huge mistakes.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に限ってそんなヘマはしないと思うが、アイツは時々とんでもないポカをするようだし。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Rin is unlikely to make a mistake, though she occasionally commits spectacular blunders.
findings.explanation: Rin avoiding a blunder becomes Rin not getting into trouble.

findings.highlight: Then the bloodstain and swollen finger would make sense—Hey wait!!!
findings.evidenceJa: それなら手についている血の跡も、指の痣も納得がいく—って、ちょっと待てーーーーーっっっ！！！
findings.governingReading: After hearing she punched Shinji, Shirou sees that the blood and bruise on her finger make sense.
findings.explanation: A bruise on Rin’s finger becomes the earlier swelling again.

findings.highlight: "Of course I did. Yesterday morning, Shinji called me up to tell me, all proud, about how he became a Master, like some kind of hotshot. It kind of pissed me off, so I told him you were a Master too.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ええ、話したわよ？　昨日の朝だったかな。慎二のヤツ、わたしを呼びつけて僕もマスターになったから遠坂と同じさ、なんて偉そうに言ってくるんだもの。なんか頭に来てね、それじゃあ士郎も同じよって言ってやったの。
findings.governingReading: Rin reports Shinji boasting that becoming a Master makes him equal to her; she answers that Shirou is therefore equal too.
findings.explanation: Shinji's explicit claim to equal Rin becomes general boasting about being a Master. This weakens the direct link between his claim and Rin's reply that Shirou qualifies too.

findings.highlight: Shinji was already smitten with Tohsaka, so what she told him is just adding fuel to the fire.
findings.evidenceJa: ただでさえ慎二は遠坂を意識していたのに、これじゃあ火に油をそそぐようなものだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Shinji was already especially conscious of or fixated on Rin before the provocation.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s prior fixation on Rin becomes established romantic infatuation.

findings.highlight: I'll have you know that I have to be the first to win.
findings.evidenceJa: わたし、勝負ごとは先出しじゃないと気が済まないの。
findings.governingReading: Rin says she cannot be satisfied unless she makes the first move in a contest or undertaking.
findings.explanation: Rin needing to initiate a contest becomes needing to win first.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka thinks really hard, but she's acting as if she really doesn't remember.
findings.evidenceJa: よく覚えていないのか、うーん、と遠坂は考え込む。
findings.governingReading: Rin thinks hard because she does not seem to remember her answer clearly.
findings.explanation: Rin apparently not remembering becomes acting as though she does not.

findings.highlight: If she likes to make the first move, she's probably not great when she has to react to someone else.
findings.evidenceJa: そりゃあ先出しが好きなら、さぞ後出しには弱かろうってもんだ。
findings.governingReading: Rin likes moving first; Shirou turns that preference into a rock-paper-scissors joke about being vulnerable to someone else's late throw.
findings.explanation: Shirou jokes that moving first leaves Rin vulnerable to an opponent's late throw. English turns this into a general difficulty reacting to others, losing the game's specific trick.

findings.highlight: "Then go tell that burglar to eat her vegetables as well as meat. And tell her not to eat all the dessert in the fridge, if that's what she was really after. Honestly, you're not like a hungry wild beast or anything..."
findings.evidenceJa: 「じゃあその泥棒にいっとけ。肉ばっかり食うんじゃなくて野菜もとれってな。それと狙いすましたように冷蔵庫のデザートを平らげるなと。まったく、飢えた獣じゃあるまいし」
findings.governingReading: Shirou continues Taiga’s fiction by telling the supposed burglar to eat vegetables too.
findings.explanation: The unknown refrigerator burglar receives a female pronoun.

findings.highlight: Hm. She's not the type to dwell on things like Shinji for so long, so there must be something else bothering her.
findings.evidenceJa: ……ふむ。慎二の件をここまで引っぱってくるようなヤツじゃなし、なんか気に障るコトでもあったんだろうか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether something else may have rubbed Rin the wrong way.
findings.explanation: Wondering whether something bothered Rin becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: For some reason, Tohsaka say this with the same miffed tone she had when we were eating dinner.
findings.evidenceJa: なぜか、食事時と同じ不機嫌さで遠坂はそんなコトを言った。
findings.governingReading: Shirou notices that Rin speaks with the same displeasure she displayed at dinner.
findings.explanation: “Tohsaka say” needs a verb correction. The passage still conveys Rin's displeasure at Shirou's growing closeness with Saber.

findings.highlight: ...And I'll take the day off school tomorrow too. Come to my room in the afternoon."
findings.evidenceJa: ……それと、明日からはわたしも学校を休むから。午後はわたしのところに来なさいよね」
findings.governingReading: Rin says that starting tomorrow she too will stop attending school, then orders Shirou to come in the afternoon.
findings.explanation: Rin’s absence beginning tomorrow becomes one day off.
